disambiguation: It is a Git version control tool, not a general file synchronization service.
extras: This plugin is distributed on GitHub and has not been submitted to the Obsidian community directory.
intentEvidence: An Obsidian plugin for synchronizing a vault with Git on macOS, Windows, and Linux.
problem: Managing version control and synchronizing a local Obsidian vault with remote Git repositories is complex and requires external tools.

relations.evidence: This is the desktop companion to VaultBridge for iPhone.

summary: Git Sync Desktop is a desktop plugin that synchronizes an Obsidian vault with a remote Git repository, supporting Git LFS and providing one-click sync controls.
